dualhotbar.settings.title: Dual Hotbar Settings
dualhotbar.options.scale.tooltip: Size of the second hotbar compared to the normal hotbar.
dualhotbar.options.overlap.tooltip: How far the second hotbar sits below the top of the hotbar, in the second hotbar's own pixels.
dualhotbar.options.animation.tooltip: How long the two hotbars take to trade places.
dualhotbar.options.scrollToSwap.tooltip: Scroll while holding the Swap Modifier key (Shift by default) to swap the hotbars.
dualhotbar.options.selectableSecondBar.t: Lets the items in the second hotbar be selected.
dualhotbar.options.scrollPastEdge.toolti: Scrolling past either end of a hotbar moves the selection onto the other one.
dualhotbar.options.doubleTapNumberKeys.t: Pressing a number key twice quickly selects that slot of the second hotbar; pressing it once goes back to the hotbar.
dualhotbar.settings.overlapWarning: Selected Items Will Overlap Main Hotbar
dualhotbar.settings.selectionNote: To hold a second-bar item, Dual Hotbar secretly swaps it into the hotbar inventory slot.
